Two distinct presentation formats in one site
challenge: Complex AI research and case studies need presentation formats that adapt to different content types. Some material works best as traditional slide decks, while other content requires indexed documentation. The challenge was creating a unified platform that could house both presentation styles with an engaging entry point that makes technical content approachable, all without relying on JavaScript for animations.
approach: Built a versatile platform with three distinct sections: a CSS-animated homepage featuring glassmorphic tiles with micro-interactions, two presentation deck areas for AI voice marketing research and agentic workflow implementations, and a markdown-based index system that auto-converts documentation to clean HTML. The homepage animations use pure CSS for smooth performance, with hover and focus states guiding users naturally to different content areas. Integrated Jekyll for markdown processing, enabling rapid documentation updates without touching HTML.
result: The platform delivers comprehensive AI research across multiple formats while maintaining visual cohesion and fast load times. The CSS-only animation approach keeps the homepage performant even with complex visual effects. The dual presentation system accommodates both slide-deck-style summaries and detailed indexed documentation, making technical concepts accessible to different audiences. The markdown integration enables publishing new research findings in minutes rather than hours.
